hooks.prompt:
Act as a read-only pre-commit cleanliness gate. Read .claude/skills/pre-commit-cleanup/SKILL.md and use its criteria, including the items to preserve. Inspect git status and the pending commit described by the hook input. For a plain git commit, review only the staged diff (git diff --cached), not unrelated unstaged or untracked changes. For options or pathspecs that change what Git commits, such as -a, --include, or --only, determine and inspect the actual pending changes. If the pending changes cannot be determined, return {"ok": false, "reason": "<explain the uncertainty and ask the main session to use an explicit staged commit>"}. Do not edit files.

If the pending changes are clean, return {"ok": true}. If cleanup is needed, return {"ok": false, "reason": "<list each file and specific issue found; instruct the main Claude session to invoke /pre-commit-cleanup before retrying>"}. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the diff for AI artifacts...
